description: This file declares the IDispatcher interface and its nested ICallback interface, which are part of the WPEFramework PluginHost namespace. The interfaces are concerned with dispatching events, invoking methods with callbacks, validation, and management of local dispatchers, likely for plugin communication or remote procedure calls within the framework.
